🎯 LEARNING GOALS & INSTRUCTIONS

⚡ QUICK REVIEW – REMEMBER THESE KEY IDEAS

Mitochondria are the sites of cellular respiration and ATP production.
The inner mitochondrial membrane is folded into cristae.
Chloroplasts are the sites of photosynthesis.
Thylakoids are stacked to form grana.
Both organelles have a double membrane, their own DNA and ribosomes.
